ATLANTA POLICE DEPARTMENT
ARREST REPORT

Case Number: JD-2024-00142
Date of Arrest: January 15, 2024
Time of Arrest: 02:35 AM

ARRESTEE INFORMATION:
Name: DOE, JOHN
DOB: 05/12/1992
Address: 1234 Peachtree St NE, Atlanta, GA 30309

ARRESTING OFFICER:
Officer James Smith, Badge #4521
Atlanta Police Department, Zone 3

ASSISTING OFFICER:
Officer Maria Garcia, Badge #3847
Atlanta Police Department, Zone 3

LOCATION OF ARREST:
Peachtree St and Andrew Young International Blvd, Atlanta, GA

NARRATIVE:
On January 15, 2024, at approximately 0230 hours, I, Officer James Smith,
was conducting routine patrol in the area of Peachtree St and Andrew Young
International Blvd.

I observed the subject, later identified as JOHN DOE, standing on the
southwest corner of the intersection. Upon seeing my patrol vehicle, the
subject appeared nervous and began walking away at a rapid pace.

I exited my vehicle and approached the subject. As I approached, I observed
the subject reach into his right jacket pocket and discard a small clear
plastic bag onto the sidewalk. I recovered the bag, which contained a white
powdery substance.

I conducted a field test on the substance, which tested positive for cocaine.
The substance weighed approximately 2.3 grams.

I placed the subject under arrest and advised him of his Miranda rights at
approximately 0235 hours. The subject stated he understood his rights and
declined to make a statement.

The subject was transported to the Zone 3 precinct for processing.

EVIDENCE:
- One (1) clear plastic bag containing white powdery substance (cocaine),
  approximately 2.3 grams
- Field test kit #FT-2024-0891 (positive for cocaine)

CHARGES:
O.C.G.A. § 16-13-30(a) - Possession of a Controlled Substance (Felony)
